```{r library packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(gt)
library(treemap)
library(scales)
library(ggfittext)
library(ggtext)
library(fmsb)
library(plotly)
library(ggrepel)
```


```{r Import Data}
A <- read_csv("A.csv")
B <- read_csv("B.csv")
C <- read_csv("C.csv")
```


```{r Data B Exposure Preparation }
B_Most_Exposure <- B |> 
  filter(PM2.5_Annual_Exposure == max(PM2.5_Annual_Exposure, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  slice(1)
B_Least_Exposure <- B |> 
  filter(PM2.5_Annual_Exposure == min(PM2.5_Annual_Exposure, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  slice(1)
B_Average_Exposure <- B |> 
  summarise(mean(PM2.5_Annual_Exposure, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull()
period <- B |> 
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      Year >= 1990 & Year <= 1999 ~ "1990 - 1999",
       Year >= 2000 & Year <= 2009 ~ "2000 - 2009",
       Year >= 2010 & Year <= 2019 ~ "2010 - 2019",
       Year >= 2020 & Year <= 2023 ~ "2020 - 2023"
    )
  )
mean_period <-   period |> 
  filter(Income_Level != "..") |> 
  group_by(period, Income_Level) |> 
  summarise(mean_PM2.5_AnnualExposure = mean(PM2.5_Annual_Exposure, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")
```

```{r Smooth Annual Exposure Chart Creation}
#| title: "PM2.5 air pollution annual exposure"
p_exposure <- B |> 
  group_by(Year) |> 
  summarise(
    Average_PM2.5_Exposure = mean(
      PM2.5_Annual_Exposure,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Year,
    y = Average_PM2.5_Exposure
    )
  ) +
  geom_point(
    size = 1.5,
    color = "#2C7A7B"
  ) +
  geom_smooth(
    method = "lm",
    se = FALSE,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    color = "#D97757"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Population-Weighted PM2.5 Exposure",
    subtitle = "Mean population-weighted exposure across ADB developing member economies, 1990–2023",
    x = NULL,
    y = "PM2.5\n(µg/m³)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11.5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold",
      color = "#243B53"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "#627D98"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "#486581",
      face = "bold",
      angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5,
      lineheight = 0.9,
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 9.5,
      color = "#486581"
    ),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "#D9E2EC",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#FCFDFD",
      colour = NA
    ),
    plot.background = element_rect(
      fill = "#FCFDFD",
      colour = NA
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 2)
  )
```

```{r Heatmap Annual Exposure Chart Creation}
#| title: PM2.5 Exposure by Income Level
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8
mean_period$Income_Level <- factor(mean_period$Income_Level, levels = c("L", "LM", "UM", "H"))
p_heatmap <-  mean_period |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(x = period, y = Income_Level, 
        fill = mean_PM2.5_AnnualExposure,
      text = paste0(
        "Period: ", period,
        "<br>Income level: ", Income_Level,
        "<br>PM2.5 exposure: ",
        round(mean_PM2.5_AnnualExposure, 1), " µg/m³"
      )
        )
  ) + 
  geom_tile(
    color = "#F7F9F9",
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  coord_fixed() +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#B8D8D8",
    high = "#176B6B",
    name = "PM2.5\n(µg/m³)"
  ) + 
  geom_text(
    aes(label = round(mean_PM2.5_AnnualExposure, 1)),
    color = "#334E68",
    size = 8,
    fontface = "bold") + 
   labs(
    title = "PM2.5 Exposure Heatmap",
    subtitle = "Mean population-weighted PM2.5 exposure by income level and period",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      color = "#243B53"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "#2C7A7B",
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      color = "#243B53",
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      color = "#243B53",
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    
    legend.title = element_text(
      color = "#243B53",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    legend.text = element_text(
      color = "#243B53"
    ),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FCFDFD", colour = NA),
  plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#FCFDFD", colour = NA),
    
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    
    plot.margin = margin(10, 5, 10, 5)
  )
```

```{r BarChart Annual Exposure Chart Creation}
p_bar <-  period |> 
  filter(!is.na(PM2.5_Annual_Exposure), !is.na(Subregion)) |> 
  group_by(Subregion, period) |> 
  summarise(
    mean_PM2.5 = mean(PM2.5_Annual_Exposure),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = period, y = mean_PM2.5, fill = Subregion)) + 
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
           width = 0.7) + 
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "#176B6B",
    "#2C7A7B",
    "#4F8F8F",
    "#7FA9A9",
    "#B8D8D8",
    "#D97757"
    ),
    labels = \(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 22)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "PM2.5 Exposure Grouped Bar Chart",
    subtitle = "Mean population-weighted PM2.5 exposure across 6 ADB subregions",
    x = NULL,
    y = "PM2.5\n(µg/m³)",
    fill = "Subregion"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FCFDFD", colour = NA),
  plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#FCFDFD", colour = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 20,
      face = "bold",
      color = "#243B53"
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 14,
      color = "#2C7A7B",
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      color = "#243B53",
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      color = "#243B53"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      color = "#243B53",
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = 12),
       angle = 0,
      vjust = 0.5,
  hjust = 0.5,
      lineheight = 0.9
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      color = "#243B53",
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      color = "#243B53",
      size = 14
    ),
   legend.key.size = unit(0.8, "cm"),

    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      color = "#D9E2EC",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 5, 10, 5)
  ) + 
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      ncol = 1,
      byrow = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r B - Table Creation}
B_Table <- head(B, 100) |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(
    title = md("**PM2.5 Annual Exposure Dataset**"),
    subtitle = "Asian Development Bank Economies · 1990–2023"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#B8D8D8"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = c(Economy_code, Country, Year)
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "#FDE8E2"),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = PM2.5_Annual_Exposure
    )
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "#243B53"),
      cell_text(color = "#FFFFFF", weight = "bold")
    ),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = Income_Level
    )
  ) |>
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(12),
    heading.background.color = "#176B6B",
    heading.title.font.size = px(20),
    heading.title.font.weight = "bold",
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(12),
    column_labels.background.color = "#2C7A7B",
    table.border.top.color = "#176B6B",
    table.border.bottom.color = "#176B6B",
    row.striping.background_color = "#F7F9F9"
  )
```


```{r Data C Concentration Preparation}
C_Total <- C |> 
  filter(!is.na(Total_Concentration_PM2.5)) |> 
  group_by(Economy_code, Country) |> 
  summarise(Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration = mean(Total_Concentration_PM2.5,
                                                  na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

world <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

C_map_Total <- world |> 
  left_join(
    C_Total,
    by = c("iso_a3" = "Economy_code")
  )

C_top24 <-  C_Total |> 
  arrange(desc(Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration)) |> 
  slice (1:24)

C_bottom24 <-  C_Total |> 
  arrange((Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration)) |> 
  slice (1:24)

C_dropNA <-  C |> 
  drop_na(Total_Concentration_PM2.5, Urban_Concentration_PM2.5, Rural_Concentration_PM2.5, Income_Level, Subregion)

C_2019 <- C_dropNA |> 
  filter(year == 2019)

C_lollipop <-  C_2019 |> 
  group_by(Subregion) |> 
  summarise(mean_Rural_Concentration_PM2.5 = mean(Rural_Concentration_PM2.5),
            mean_Urban_Concentration_PM2.5 = 
              mean(Urban_Concentration_PM2.5))

C_lollipop_long <- C_lollipop |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      mean_Rural_Concentration_PM2.5,
      mean_Urban_Concentration_PM2.5
    ),
    names_to = "Type",
    values_to = "Concentration"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Type = case_when(
      Type == "mean_Rural_Concentration_PM2.5" ~ "Rural",
      Type == "mean_Urban_Concentration_PM2.5" ~ "Urban"
    )
  )

C_dropNA <-  C |> 
  drop_na(Total_Concentration_PM2.5, Urban_Concentration_PM2.5, Rural_Concentration_PM2.5, Income_Level, Subregion)

C_color <-  C_dropNA |>
  filter(year == 2019) |> 
  mutate(
    Disparity = abs(
      Urban_Concentration_PM2.5 - Rural_Concentration_PM2.5
    )
  ) |> 
  select(-c(Country, Total_Concentration_PM2.5, year, Subregion)) |> 
  relocate(Disparity, .after = "Economy_code")
```

```{r World Map Total Concentration Chart Creation}
p_map <-  ggplot(C_map_Total) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(
      key = Country,
      fill = Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration,
      text = paste0(
  "<b>", Country, "</b>",
  "<br>Average PM2.5: ",
  round(Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration, 2),
  " µg/m³"
)
        ),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.2
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "#B8D8D8",
      "#9CCBCB",
      "#80BDBD",
      "#64AEAE",
      "#4A9A9A",
      "#2C7A7B",
      "#256B70",
      "#243B53"
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70)),
    limits = c(0, 70),
    name = "Average PM2.5\nconcentration",
    na.value = "#AFC4CC"
  ) +
  
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(20, 200),
    ylim = c(-60, 85),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  
  theme(
     # OCEAN
  panel.background = element_rect(
    fill = "#D9E3E8",
    colour = NA
  ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 8,
      colour = "#243B53"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
     legend.key.height = unit(0.8, "cm"),
  legend.key.width = unit(0.35, "cm"),

  legend.spacing = unit(2, "pt"),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )
p_map_plotly <- ggplotly(p_map, tooltip = "text") |> 
   layout(
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#F7F9F9",
      bordercolor = "#B8D8D8",
      font = list(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 6,
        color = "#243B53"
      ),
      namelength = 0
    )
  )

for (i in seq_along(p_map_plotly$x$data)) {
  if (!is.null(p_map_plotly$x$data[[i]]$fill)) {
    p_map_plotly$x$data[[i]]$hoveron <- "fills"
  }
}
```

```{r Top 24 Rank Total Concentration Chart Creation}
p_top <-  ggplot(
  C_top24,
  aes(
    key = Country,
    ids = Country,
    x = Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration,
    y = reorder(Country, Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration),
    fill = Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration,
    text = paste0(
      "<b>", Country, "</b>",
      "<br>PM2.5: ",
      round(Average_TotalPM2.5_Concentration, 2),
      " µg/m³"
    )
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
  colours = c(
    "#B8D8D8",
  "#9CCBCB",
  "#80BDBD",
  "#64AEAE",
  "#4A9A9A",
  "#2C7A7B",
  "#256B70",
  "#243B53"
  ),
  values = scales::rescale(c(0, 15, 30, 45, 70)),
  limits = c(0, 70),
  name = "PM2.5\n(µg/m³)"
) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 70),
    breaks = seq(0, 70, 14)
  ) + 
  scale_y_discrete(
  labels = \(x) stringr::str_wrap(x, width = 18)
) +
  labs(
    x = "PM2.5\n(µg/m³)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
 theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +

  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FCFDFD", colour = NA),
  plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#FCFDFD", colour = NA),
    # Country labels
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 30,
      colour = "#243B53",
      face = "bold",
      margin = margin(r = 4),
      lineheight = 0.85
    ),

    # X axis
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 30,
      colour = "#243B53"
    ),

    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 30,
      colour = "#243B53",
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),

    # Grid
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(
      colour = "#E5EAEA",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),

    # Legend
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 30,
      colour = "#243B53"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24,
                               color = "#243B53"),
    legend.key.height = unit(2, "cm"),
  legend.key.width = unit(0.5, "cm"),

    # Plot spacing
    plot.margin = margin(5, 2, 5, 0)
  )
p_top_plotly <- ggplotly(p_top, tooltip = "text") |>
  layout(
    hoverlabel = list(
      bgcolor = "#F7F9F9",
      bordercolor = "#B8D8D8",
      font = list(
        family = "Arial",
        size = 13,
        color = "#243B53"
      ),
      namelength = 0
    ),
    
    autosize = TRUE,
    margin = list(l = 100, r = 40, t = 20, b = 60),
    xaxis = list(
      tickfont = list(size = 10),
      title = list(font = list(size = 9))
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      tickfont = list(size = 10),
      title = list(font = list(size = 9))
    )
  )

p_top_plotly <- plotly_build(p_top_plotly)

for (i in seq_along(p_top_plotly$x$data)) {
  cb <- p_top_plotly$x$data[[i]]$marker$colorbar

  if (!is.null(cb)) {
    p_top_plotly$x$data[[i]]$marker$colorbar$tickfont <-
      list(size = 8)

    p_top_plotly$x$data[[i]]$marker$colorbar$titlefont <-
      list(size = 9)

    p_top_plotly$x$data[[i]]$marker$colorbar$thickness <- 15
    p_top_plotly$x$data[[i]]$marker$colorbar$len <- 0.7
  }
}

```

```{r Lollipop Urban vs Rural Chart Creation}
p_lollipop <- ggplot(data = C_lollipop, aes(y = Subregion)) +
  
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = mean_Rural_Concentration_PM2.5,
      xend = mean_Urban_Concentration_PM2.5,
      yend = Subregion
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    color = "#B8D8D8"

  geom_point(
    data = C_lollipop_long,

  hjust = 1,

    ),
```

```{r Bubble Urban vs Rural Chart Creation}
p_bubble <-  C_dropNA |>
  filter(year == 2019) |> 
  mutate(
    Disparity = abs(
      Urban_Concentration_PM2.5 - Rural_Concentration_PM2.5
    )
  ) |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = Rural_Concentration_PM2.5,
      y = Urban_Concentration_PM2.5,
      size = Disparity,
      colour = Income_Level
    )
  ) +
  geom_abline(
    slope = 1,
    intercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    colour = "#D46F52"
  ) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(3, 12),

  scale_colour_manual(

    "L"  = "#D97757",  
    "LM" = "#D9A441",  
    "UM" = "#8FC8C2",  
    "H"  = "#AAB8C8"   
    ),
    name = "Income Level"
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = "Rural (µg/m³)",
    y = "Urban (µg/m³)"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FCFDFD", colour = NA),
  plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "#FCFDFD", colour = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(
    size = 16,
    color = "#243B53"
  ),
  axis.text.y = element_text(

    color = "#243B53"

  axis.title.x = element_text(

    color = "#243B53",

  ),
  axis.title.y = element_text(
    size = 18,

    size = 16,
    color = "#243B53",
    face = "bold"
  ),
  legend.text = element_text(

) +
```

```{r Data A Emissions Preparation}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
Income_2022 <- A |> 
  filter(year == 2022) |> 
  select(Economy_code, Income_Level)

Income_add <- income_fix <- tibble(
  Economy_code = c("CHN", "HKG", "IRN", "KOR", "LAO", "TWN"),
  Income_Level = c("UM", "H", "UM", "H", "LM", "H")
)

A_tree <-  A |> 
  filter(!Economy_code %in% c("FSM", "NRU")) |> 
  group_by(Economy_code, Country) |> 
  summarise(
    Total_PM2.5 = sum(Total_PM2.5_emissions, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  left_join(Income_2022, by = "Economy_code") |> 
  mutate(
    Income_Level = case_when(
      Economy_code %in% Income_add$Economy_code ~
        Income_add$Income_Level[
          match(Economy_code, Income_add$Economy_code)
        ],
      TRUE ~ Income_Level
    )
  ) 

A_tree <- A_tree |> 
  arrange(desc(Total_PM2.5)) |> 
  mutate(id_tree = row_number())

data_tree <- treemap(
  A_tree,
  index = c("Country"),
  vSize = "Total_PM2.5",
  type = "categorical",
  vColor = "Income_Level",
  algorithm = "pivotSize",
  sortID = "id_tree",
  mirror.y = TRUE,
  mirror.x = TRUE,
  border.lwds = 0.7,
  aspRatio = 5/3
)

data_ggplot <- data_tree[["tm"]] |> 
  as_tibble() |> 
  arrange(desc(vSize)) |> 
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    xmax = x0 + w,
    ymax = y0 + h,
    label_country = str_glue(
      "{Country}\n({comma(vSize, accuracy = 1)})"
    )
  )

A_dropNA <- A |> 
  drop_na(Road_PM2.5_emissions,
    Railways_PM2.5_emissions,
    Navigation_PM2.5_emissions,
    Aviation_PM2.5_emissions)

A_4mode <- A_dropNA |> 
  select(- Total_PM2.5_emissions) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      Road_PM2.5_emissions,
      Railways_PM2.5_emissions,
      Navigation_PM2.5_emissions,
      Aviation_PM2.5_emissions
  ),
  names_to = "Transport_Mode",
  values_to = "PM2.5_Emissions" )

A_share <-  A_4mode |> 
  group_by(Transport_Mode) |> 
  summarise(
    Total_emissions = sum(PM2.5_Emissions, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    share = Total_emissions/ sum(Total_emissions)
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    share_percent = formattable::percent(share)
  )

A_spider <- A_share |> 
  select(Transport_Mode, share) |> 
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Transport_Mode,
    values_from = share
  )

A_spider_chart <- rbind(
  rep(0.6, 4),  # max = 50%
  rep(0, 4),    # min = 0%
  A_spider
)

colnames(A_spider_chart) <- c(
  "Aviation",
  "Navigation",
  "Railways",
  "Road"
)

A_Percent <-  A_dropNA |> 
  filter(!is.na(Subregion)) |> 
  group_by(Subregion) |> 
  summarise(
    sum_Total_PM2.5Emissions = sum(
      Total_PM2.5_emissions,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Total_percent = sum_Total_PM2.5Emissions /
      sum(sum_Total_PM2.5Emissions)
  )

A_Percent <- A_Percent |> 
  mutate(
    Region = case_when(
      Subregion %in% c(
        "Developing Southeast Asia",
        "Caucasus and Central and West Asia"
      ) ~ "Other Asia",
      TRUE ~ Subregion
    )
  ) |> 
  group_by(Region) |> 
  summarise(
    sum_Total_PM2.5Emissions = sum(
      sum_Total_PM2.5Emissions
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    Total_percent = sum_Total_PM2.5Emissions /
      sum(sum_Total_PM2.5Emissions)
  )

A_radial <- A_Percent |> 
  arrange(desc(Total_percent)) |> 
  mutate(
    Region = factor(Region, levels = Region),
    Percent = formattable::percent(Total_percent)
  )

A_radial <- A_radial |> 
  mutate(
    label = factor(
      paste0(Region, " - ", Percent),
      levels = rev(paste0(Region, " - ", Percent))
    )
  )

A_card <- A_dropNA |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(
    Total_Emissions = sum(Total_PM2.5_emissions, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

A_card_max <- A_card |> 
  slice_max(Total_Emissions, n = 1)
A_card_min <- A_card |> 
  slice_min(Total_Emissions, n = 1)
A_card_average <- A_card |> 
  summarise(
    Average = mean(Total_Emissions)
  )
```

```{r TreeMap Emission Chart Creation}
p_tree <- ggplot(data_ggplot) +
  geom_rect(

      xmin = x0,

    ),

  geom_fit_text(

    aes(

      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = y0,

      label = label_country

  labs(
    title = "Cumulative PM2.5 Emissions tree map",

    ),

    ),

  )
```

```{r Donut Emission Chart Creation}
p_donut <- A_radial |>
  mutate(
    Region = as.character(Region),
    ymax = cumsum(Total_percent),
    ymin = c(0, head(ymax, n = -1)),
    labelPosition = (ymax + ymin) / 2,
    Percent = formattable::percent(Total_percent, digits = 1)
  ) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      ymax = ymax,
      ymin = ymin,
      xmax = 4.4,

  geom_rect(

  geom_text(

    )

  labs(fill = NULL) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  xlim(c(0, 4.8)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(

    ),

    ),
```

# Data Sources

## {.sidebar}

### Overview

This dashboard presents statistics on PM2.5 exposure, concentration, and emissions across Asian and Pacific economies, using data from the Asian Development Bank (ADB) Data Bank.
